dialog.fanRestoreSpeed: Restore the last fan speed when turned on (Apple Home's power button injects 100%). Only a 100% or High command while off is treated as power-on; lower speeds set while off are kept, so you cannot start an off fan at full speed.
dialog.selectExposeAsSwitch: Expose as an on/off switch (controllers can't render select options over Matter). On and off each pick one option below. Re-pair after changing.
dialog.vacuumAscendingRoomOrder: Vacuum cleans rooms in ascending area ID order, not in the order they were picked (Roborock batch cleaning). Fixes the room shown as current and the room progress when the picking order differs.
dialog.disableCustomAreaRoomModes: Don't expose rooms as per-room cleaning modes (forces Apple Home to use the multi-room area picker). Keep off for Google Home / Alexa, which rely on the modes.
dialog.vacuumRoomSwitches: Expose one momentary switch per area next to the vacuum, so platforms that can't send multi-room commands (e.g. SmartThings routines) can start cleaning a single area by turning its switch on.
dialog.coverSwapOpenClose: Swap open/close commands (for awnings and similar covers)
dialog.coverOpenCloseAsPosition: Send open/close as position 100% / 0% (for covers that stop instead of reversing on open/close while moving)
dialog.coverExposeAsDimmableLight: Expose as a dimmable light (Alexa workaround: level = open %, on/off = open/close). Keep off for Apple / Google.
dialog.disableLockPin: Disable PIN requirement for this lock
dialog.lockWithoutPin: Lock has no keypad: offer no PIN codes to controllers (re-pair after changing)
dialog.disableClimateOnOff: Disable on/off for this climate entity (keeps the thermostat running when a room is turned off by voice)
dialog.disableClimateFanControl: Expose as plain Thermostat (drop FanControl), workaround for controllers like Aqara that don't recognise the air conditioner device type. Needs a full HAMH restart, then re-pair the bridge in the controller (Aqara caches the device list)
dialog.climateKeepModeOnIdle: Keep last mode on Matter while off + idle (workaround for ACs that report off + hvac_action=idle during internal cleaning, so the controller's Off button stays actionable)
dialog.climateForceTurnOn: Always send climate.turn_on (for IR controlled ACs, where Home Assistant can report on while the device is off)
dialog.climateBlockOff: Refuse Off from Matter controllers (the entity keeps its mode, e.g. a heating schedule; changing the temperature still works)
dialog.climateExposeFan: Expose a companion Fan device (adds a separate Apple Home fan tile for fan_only mode and speed, only for ACs with a fan mode, and re-pairs this AC once)
dialog.disableBatteryMapping: Disable battery mapping (skip an auto-detected or manually mapped battery sensor for this entity; use when an integration like Xiaomi Home reports a bogus battery sensor on a mains-powered device, causing a false low-battery warning in Matter controllers)
dialog.disableMomentaryFlip: Do not report the on/off flip after a run. Try this when Alexa devices on script bridges stop responding.
dialog.entityIdHelp: Search or enter the Home Assistant entity ID (e.g., light.living_room)
dialog.customNameHelp: Override the entity name shown in Matter controllers
dialog.filterLifeSensorHelp: Sensor entity that provides filter life percentage (0-100%) for HEPA filter monitoring
dialog.fanSliderDebounceHelp: Wait this long after the last inbound fan-speed write before sending it to Home Assistant. Controllers stream writes while a slider is dragged; on IR or UART bridged ACs every write makes the unit beep. 0 / empty uses the bridge setting (default off). Try 1000-2000. Max 5000.
dialog.cleaningModeEntityHelp: Select entity that controls the vacuum cleaning mode (e.g., select.r2_d2_cleaning_mode for Dreame vacuums)
dialog.suctionLevelEntityHelp: Select entity that controls suction level. Adds Quiet/Max intensity options to Apple Home's extra features panel.
dialog.mopIntensityEntityHelp: Select entity that controls mop water level / intensity. Adds intensity options when mopping in Apple Home.
dialog.currentRoomEntityHelp: Sensor that reports which room the vacuum is currently in (e.g. Dreame current_room sensor). Enables dynamic room progress tracking during multi-room cleaning.
dialog.faultEntityHelp: Error enum sensor. Auto-detected for Roborock; an explicit sensor overrides automatic detection.
dialog.readinessEntityHelp: Reports map processing and start-blocking conditions. Ready must remain stable for five seconds. Requires a controller that supports the newer Matter vacuum states; leave empty for older controllers.
dialog.chargingStateEntityHelp: Sensor reporting the charging state (e.g. Xiaomi charging_state: charging / not_charging / full). Drives the Matter charge state directly instead of inferring it from docked + battery level.
dialog.cleanedAreaEntityHelp: Sensor reporting cumulative cleaned area in m². With a Size (m²) set on each area, advances room progress for batch vacuums that report area but not the current room.
dialog.valetudoIdentifierHelp: Exact identifier from Valetudo Connectivity > MQTT. Only needed if it differs from the lowercase entity ID.
dialog.roomButtonsHelp: Select button entities that trigger room cleaning (e.g., button.roborock_clean_kitchen). These appear as rooms in Apple Home.
dialog.humiditySensorHelp: Combine with a humidity sensor to create a single Temperature+Humidity device
dialog.pressureSensorHelp: Combine with a pressure sensor to create a single Temperature+Pressure device
dialog.batterySensorHelp: Include battery level from a separate sensor entity
dialog.purifierTemperatureHelp: Add temperature measurement to this air purifier from a separate sensor entity
dialog.purifierHumidityHelp: Add humidity measurement to this air purifier from a separate sensor entity
dialog.powerSensorHelp: Sensor with device_class: power (W), adds real-time power measurement to this device
dialog.energySensorHelp: Sensor with device_class: energy (kWh), adds cumulative energy measurement to this device
dialog.voltageSensorHelp: Sensor with device_class: voltage (V), folds voltage into the power measurement
dialog.currentSensorHelp: Sensor with device_class: current (A), folds current into the power measurement
dialog.meterPowerHelp: Sensor with device_class: power (W). Leave empty to use this entity's own value.
dialog.meterEnergyHelp: Sensor with device_class: energy (kWh), adds cumulative energy to this meter
dialog.meterVoltageHelp: Sensor with device_class: voltage (V), folded into this meter
dialog.meterCurrentHelp: Sensor with device_class: current (A), folded into this meter
dialog.meterSerialNumberHelp: Serial number reported via MeterIdentification. Empty reports null.
dialog.pointOfDeliveryHelp: Metering point id reported via MeterIdentification. Empty reports null.
dialog.chargingSwitchHelp: Switch that starts and stops charging. EnableCharging turns it on, Disable turns it off.
dialog.currentLimitHelp: Number entity (amperes) for the charge current limit. Feeds MaximumChargeCurrent.
dialog.evsePowerHelp: Sensor with device_class: power (W), adds real-time power to this charger
dialog.evseEnergyHelp: Sensor with device_class: energy (kWh), adds cumulative energy to this charger
dialog.batteryPowerSensorHelp: Sensor with device_class: power (W). Positive on discharge, negative on charge. Exposes the battery as an ESS.
dialog.batteryEnergySensorHelp: Sensor with device_class: energy (kWh), adds lifetime throughput to the battery
dialog.coverSliderDebounceHelp: Override for slow blinds. 0 / empty uses bridge setting (default 400/150ms two-phase). Try 800-1500 for sluggish covers. Max 5000.
dialog.lockUsercodeServiceHelp: Opt-in: also program the physical lock when a controller sets/clears the PIN, e.g. zwave_js.set_lock_usercode or zha.set_lock_user_code. Leave empty to keep the PIN only in HAMH.
dialog.lockUsercodeSlotHelp: Code slot on the physical lock, default 1
dialog.lockPinMinLengthHelp: Override advertised minimum PIN length (1-20). Default 4. Set min = max for locks that require an exact length.
dialog.lockPinMaxLengthHelp: Override advertised maximum PIN length (1-20). Default 8. Controllers cache both lengths at pairing, re-pair the bridge after changing them.
dialog.updateThrottleHelp: Limit Matter updates for chatty sensors (power, energy) to one per N ms. Empty / 0 keeps the default. Max 60000.
dialog.lightAsOutletWarning: Every controller will see this light as a plain outlet, with no brightness or color. Only worth it to get a light's wattage into Apple Home.
dialog.windPresetHelp: Map localized preset names to Matter wind modes. Comma-separated HA preset names, e.g. 自然风 for natural wind.
dialog.customTagHelp: Map Home Assistant speeds to Matter tags. When configured these will override default speeds.
dialog.roomButtonsPlaceholder: Select room buttons or type entity ID
dialog.noRoomButtons: No button entities found for this device. You can manually enter entity IDs.
dialog.customAreasHelp: Define custom zones mapped to HA service calls. Works for lawn mowers, pool cleaners, or any zone-based robot. When configured, these replace auto-detected rooms. Data is extra JSON sent with the call. Batch fires one combined call for all selected zones instead of one per zone.
dialog.composedHelp: Group additional HA entities into this device. Each entity becomes a sub-endpoint under a shared Matter device. Requires the autoComposedDevices feature flag.
